desc: Implement full program: parse input; if A==B, check (N-1)%A==0 and no bad interval contains a square congruent to 1 modulo A.

For A<B, build maximal good/bad runs over [2,N]; initialize mask=1; simulate bad runs (length>=B clears mask) and good runs (long-run saturation otherwise simulate with reachability mask); print Yes iff final bit 0 is set.
Validate on samples and edge cases (M=0, N=2, bad runs length >=B, short gaps, A=1, A=B); sample tests passed.
